goal: Clean up peer address tracking so outbound peers' initial self-announcements can be relayed
Remove misleading relay-suppression state without weakening existing limits on large address messages
reviewability: Stale because the author has been silent for 71 days with open design questions
agreement: Support because existing size checks already guard address relay and the flag is ineffective (danielabrozzoni, w0xlt)
Concept objection: removing the flag lets peers abuse token allocations for unsolicited addrs (taki-abedesselam)
Open privacy questions about topology leakage and relaying self-announcements (ajtowns, Crypt-iQ)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it cleans up broken internal state logic that was already rendered ineffective
The change is a minor peer-to-peer cleanup with low impact on overall network relay
